authorization: User requested board PNG/JPG/JPEG export, reviewed the offscreen shared-Runtime approach, accepted background implementation and requested image export next.

decisions.owner: Read-only owner-thread Runtime export. Shared Scene visibility/ordering, DirectReferenceSource, text/image services and Skia drawing; a separate CPU raster target and encoder. No capture/resize/pan of the live surface and no second document or renderer command mapping.
decisions.capture: Capture committed semantic generation and immutable derived content. Exclude selection/caret/handles, provisional creation, drag/crop overrides, active ink and IME preedit. Export must not finish text or mutate canonical state, History, camera, selection, presentation counters, or outbound Operations. Reject reentry, wrong thread, closed/unavailable owner, conflicting publication or stale requested generation.
decisions.region: Default bounds are the union of visible non-Group canonical render records, including content outside the current viewport. Empty documents export the finite current viewport. An optional explicit world-space [left,top,right,bottom] rectangle replaces automatic bounds. Scale is pixels per world unit, default 1. Padding is output pixels, default 16; output dimensions round up and returned bounds include padding/rounding.
decisions.formats: PNG and JPEG. The JS/JSON jpg alias uses JPEG bytes and image/jpeg MIME. JPEG quality in [0,1], default 0.92. Validated PNG quality is otherwise ignored. Reuse accepted prebuilt Skia encoding; no new dependency or lock edits.
decisions.background: Default document background including its pattern; includePattern=false suppresses dots/grid. PNG may request transparent background, which excludes the background/pattern. An explicit opaque RGBA color replaces document background with a solid color. JPEG transparent requests reject; no silent black flattening or format fallback. Export composites each object erase mask within its own layer so erased regions reveal the requested background (including transparent), without changing legacy live-surface behavior.
decisions.limits: Dimensions 1..8192, at most 16777216 output pixels, at most 128 MiB encoded output; finite positive scale, finite ordered nonempty bounds, integer padding 0..1024, finite color/quality ranges. Validate dimensions before allocation; return no partial bytes on failure. Missing/failed image or required text font resources reject rather than exporting placeholders.
decisions.public_api: Web exportImage(options) returns Promise<{bytes,mimeType,width,height,bounds,generation}> with owned Uint8Array and exact decimal-string generation. Matching source facade value DTOs and Windows caller wrapper use existing JSON/owned buffer ABI; no new DLL export and no Scene/Skia/WASM-owner exposure. Demo owns filename, Blob/download and UI, using the public API only.
